import hashlib, json, os, stat, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
candidate = "52d901c50af1dde97ea22bda8efb1fdf21f169b1"
base = "41e9a07a1d20b60369839b1190410f708937784b"
target = "apps/worker/src/jobs/diagnostics/DiagnosticWorkerOwnershipBatch.e2e.spec.ts"
old = b'app.port !== "65379"'
new = b'app.port !== (process.env["DIAGNOSTIC_WORKER_OWNERSHIP_BATCH_PORT"] ?? "65379")'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args])
def tree(ref):
    result = {}
    for entry in git("ls-tree", "-rz", ref).split(b"\0"):
        if not entry: continue
        meta, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, oid = meta.decode().split()
        result[path.decode()] = {"mode": mode, "type": kind, "oid": oid}
    return result
def changed(a, b):
    return sorted(p for p in a.keys() | b.keys() if a.get(p) != b.get(p))
def source(entries):
    return {p: v for p, v in entries.items() if not p.startswith("docs/")}
head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
branch = git("branch", "--show-current").decode().strip()
ct, bt, ht = tree(candidate), tree(base), tree(head)
base_changes = changed(ct, bt)
assert all(p.startswith("docs/") for p in base_changes), base_changes
assert source(ct) == source(bt)
head_changes = changed(bt, ht)
assert head_changes == [target], head_changes
expected = git("show", f"{candidate}:{target}")
actual = git("show", f"{head}:{target}")
assert expected.count(old) == 1
assert actual == expected.replace(old, new, 1)
worktree_mismatches = []
for path, entry in source(ht).items():
    p = Path(path)
    data = os.readlink(p).encode() if entry["mode"] == "120000" else p.read_bytes()
    blob_oid = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
    if blob_oid != entry["oid"]:
        worktree_mismatches.append(path)
assert not worktree_mismatches, worktree_mismatches
assert git("status", "--porcelain").decode() == ""
print(json.dumps({
  "sourceBase": candidate, "coordinatorBase": base,
  "actualImmutableWorktreeHead": head, "branch": branch, "worktree": str(Path.cwd()),
  "coordinatorInterveningChangedPathCount": len(base_changes),
  "coordinatorInterveningChangesDocsOnly": True,
  "comparedNonDocumentationTrackedPathCount": len(source(ct)),
  "coordinatorBaseSourceEqualsCandidate": True,
  "checkpointChangesFromCoordinatorBase": head_changes,
  "checkpointSourceChangesFromCandidate": changed(source(ct), source(ht)),
  "checkpointEqualsCandidateAfterReversingOnlyAllowedPortSeam": True,
  "candidateTargetSha256": hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
  "checkpointTargetSha256": hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),
  "worktreeSourceMatchesImmutableCheckpoint": True,
  "worktreeSourceMismatches": worktree_mismatches,
  "worktreeWasClean": True
}, indent=2))
